name: MailWizz

evidence.newsletter: F02: newsletters, broadcasts and recurring campaigns
evidence.marketing: F02: autoresponders on the marketing side of the product
evidence.transactional: F02: transactional email API accepts recipient, body and a send time

line: Self-hosted email campaigns, automations and transactional API sends.

free.text: No free licence or included delivery allowance

cells.api: Yes, transactional API; connect your own mail server

subs.math: $59 a year for the licence, split over 12 months + $12 server (2GB) + Amazon SES at $0.16 per 1k emails, 32 KB per email at $0.12 per GB. 1,000 subscribers × 4 emails each. Production access; extras and tax excluded.
